text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Urrgh, why isn't it working out at all...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
As an umadol, bad skin is an absolute 
no-no! I have to cover it up somehow, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Come to think of it, what time is 
it right now?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Kyaaah!? I'm gonna be late, late, lateee!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon tried to cover up her skin 
breakout with makeup, but things just 
wouldn't go her way.
